timeline.tweet: I dunno why I've always felt awkward to like/fav tweets and preferred to RT instead. Today I change habits xD
Last work day of 2016. After being unemployed over the New Year for the past 2 years, I'm thankful that I'm working today.
FINALLY GOT TO GO CYCLING!!!!! The weather was hot but it was perfect weather for me to cycle☆ Plus, look at the A+ photos I got👀👌💯
5 November 2006 – 4 February 2018 — Early last month, we lost Frosty, our youngest lady in the family. She was just 11 years old when she suddenly left us for the heavens. We love you, Frosty.

Suddenly getting reminded of how my heart was broken by 3 various people in different situations and times last year, and thinking how I'm probably never gonna be the same again... I'm still bitter and hurt.
Started packing to move out next month... Major downsizing with very little emotion/attachment..? idk, i feel pretty emotionally drained right now from it.....

They used to bring me good memories, but now they only bring me bad memories. I realized I was such a naive person in the past, always trying to see the good in people who were just using me or hurting me.

Today's nightmare: I was a fugitive and apparently ordered to be killed on sight. It felt more like an action movie rather than a nightmare, but then narrowly missing bullets and falling through ceilings were not fun.
Moving out should never have to be this stressful.... Does anyone else experience this? I had so much joy planning, but the actual packing and moving is becoming very anxiety-inducing.
ok, at first i was so stressed at having to move out BUT NOW I CAN'T WAIT TO MOVE OUT I'M STRESSED OUT THAT I CAN'T MOVE OUT YET UGH;;;;;;;
Few more days till The Move. God, please give me the strength and courage in this new chapter in my life.

IM NOT.GONNA BOTHER WITH THREAD OR TYPOS COS I JUST!!!!!B AM SO FUCKING HAPPY!!!!!!!! I SCREM!!!!!!! I AM FUCKING HAPPY I PAID FOR MORE EX SEATS AND MADE THE DARN TRIP OUT ALONE BECOS ONLY.I CAN MAKE MAHSELF HAPPY THIS WAY!!!

What has changed since I moved out? I'm twice busier, shuttling between both homes and sleeping much later in order to do my own things. I know I sound like I'm complaining; it's hustling, that's what it's supposed to be. It'll just be nice if I didn't feel taken for granted.
On my cat IG too, a recap post. What a year it has been. We have now fully transitioned to renal care diet, and subcut fluids for Ash and Miko have been going regularly (though not always smoothly)!

My life indeed did change from my constant decluttering, and I never feel like "I've finished it all!", rather... It's a constant kinda thing..? Everytime I have new stuff, I just gotta declutter and make space. End of unpopular opinion.

I miss my Korshka and Frosty a lot, because their death anniversaries will come in the next few months. I wish they didn't have to go so soon, and that they didn't have to suffer so much before they went. I know they are watching over me and the family, I can feel them..

Been sensing a dip in my mental state recently... Perhaps I'm settling in after moving out, and faced so many fears and worries head on.. So this is another thing that I need to face head on and work out.

Gotta really make a habit of doing self-care instead of the default of feeling guilty for not wanting to do anything productive. And now, I shall sleep instead of making myself work till 3am just to feel like I did something productive today.

It's a little more to a month until the first death anniversary of my grandpa cat Korshka, and you know... I don't think I'll ever get over his death. Give me another 15 years. Applies to my other 6 cats, damn, I will never be the same if it weren't for my cats, and sorry emo;;
I did well to slowly push forward my waking up times for the past few days. Today, I woke up 15 mins before my alarm, and I hardly felt annoyed. Celebration solo dinner なう👏🏼👏🏼
Missing my Korshka very much. (Nope, I'm not going to really move on from his death, it still affects me so much.)

Plus, I think all these 4/5am sleeping is taking a toll on me, I don't feel the same;; I'm also meant to be asleep by now, but here we are at 3.30am 8);;; Whelp, at least I've already taken my sahur so I suppose I'm just going to have to endure the long day tomorrow.

The start date of my next contract job got brought forward by bout 2 weeks so I start 1 July now... Which means even less time to do what I need to do. And I'm still scared of going out of the house to work.

Every night I see a glimmer of chance to sleep early, but do I?? NO because the time from when I knock off from work till when I sleep isn't approximately 7hrs, it feels more like 3 to 4hrs, tops. That time is so short, it slips through my fingers every day.
Ya! That's the priority, drawing and having fun (cos already suffering at work, which feeds our human and material needs lololol)
23rd death anniversary on the 23rd of October, 2019

2 weeks till dezafes... Gonna make myself sleep more over this period, because I will need it haha;; It'll be tough, with all the nerves and worry and excitement that will no doubt build up. But I have ways to help with all of that, and I will utilize them all.

Finally sorted through a pile I allowed to grow steadily since I moved, thinking that someone else will be able to buy and rehome these stuff (since most it are merch), but now it's time to just put them all into the recycle bins.

So.... I'll be working from home indefinitely from now. Good and bad, the one thing for sure is that I'm gonna have to pimp my dining area and make it more workspace-esque. My room's desk is fine, however I tend to overdo it and sit 6 hours straight with minimal breaks. Not good!

Indeed, I had more time to create and make when I was unemployed. But I was also (low-key) constantly worried about my ability to take care of myself. This job has lifted much of that weight for me. ^^

The results of this time's elections were disappointing (again). "Will I ever live to see positive change?" is the question my generation is asking themselves. Unless they are the ones that contributed to this dismal outcome.

Lying in bed and realizing: full WFH week this week yessss :') LOL;;; ....idk how i will become "normal" again — or maybe — "new normal", cos right now, WFH is my new normal and work-life(/REST) balance is my new normal and non-packed places are my new normal and----
